text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One weekend in April. As promised, I 
visited Hanshin Racecourse together with 
her!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Do your best, Loves-san...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And the 'Wasurenagusa Sho' is underway! 
First, the battle for the lead among 9 
runners—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Rounding the fourth corner. Loves Only 
You pulls up alongside the leader!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...! Haaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Number 7, Loves Only You, in a commanding 
lead, pulling away! She widens the gap to 
two, three lengths!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You in the lead, crossing the 
line!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Thank you...! It was everyone's 
voices that carried me forward—!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's love reached me loud and 
clear~!

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"No, thank you...! Thank you so much, 
Loves-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations!" "So moving!" "Did you 
see Loves-chan run?!" ——Uwah, even the 
community members were watching...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It's love, isn't it—Loves-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The glorious first jewel of the 
much-anticipated Tiara Route. The Oka Sho 
is underway!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: To become the strongest miler—!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna... I'M GONNA WIIIIIIIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
On the outside is Chrono Genesis— Gran 
Alegria takes the lead and crosses the 
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A raised hand from Gran Alegria! She 
crowns her first race of the new year with 
an Oka Sho victory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria finishes in 1 minute 32.7 
seconds! Beating Almond Eye's record from 
last year, she takes the victory in record 
time!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Surpassing... Ai-san... Zenno?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Having devoted herself relentlessly to the 
mile, she claimed a record-setting victory 
in the Classic mile division.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
To think it would turn into such a 
wonderful race—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. All three of you were wonderful 
today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-san powered through the race thanks 
to her bond with the Commu-members."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Gran-san bloomed magnificently in her 
beloved mile races.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-san missed out on victory, but her 
late charge coming from the outside on the 
final stretch was incredible.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
True to the three of them, they budded 
strongly, powerfully, and burst into full 
bloom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It shone so brilliantly that it made me 
yearn to possess such a weapon myself.
choice_data_list: You have plenty of weapons of your own.

You have plenty of weapons of your own, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having the stamina to reserve power for 
the final stretch. And above all, the 
kindness of wanting to dedicate her 
victory to a single Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These are reliable weapons that will guide 
us to victory.
choice_data_list:
Let's hone that weapon of yours even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ... I see... So that is the case.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sure everything will be fine. Since 
you are the one saying so.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure I'll be able to sprout into a 
fine bud too.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(And so leaves sprout, stems grow tall, 
and someday buds will form and blossom 
into flowers.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(As long as your shining self is by my 
side.)
